paragraphs: (Maacah daughter of Abishalom, I Kings 15:2.) Rabbi Natan bar Abishalom, Berakhot 22a; Rabbi Shimon bar Abishalom, Berakhot 7b.[^1]

notes.text: The Masoretic I Kings 15:2 text names Maacah daughter of Abishalom. William Davidson Berakhot 22a and 7b fully name Rabbi Natan ben Abishalom and Rabbi Shimon ben Abishalom respectively. Hyman’s bar forms are retained; these separate attestations do not establish a shared family or identity.
